node.label: galactosialidosis
node.definition: A lysosomal storage disease characterized by coarse facial features, macular ''cherry red spot'', and dysostosis multiplex. Clinical presentation can be heterogenous ranging from a severe, early-onset, rapidly progressive infantile form to late onset, slowly progressive juvenile/adult form.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — cathepsin A
